main.description: One role an account grants to a workload identity. The record key is the role name; the record holds exactly that one role, the policies it names and what it protects.

protects.description: Map of name to {service, scope}. service is the DID of the service that enforces this record (the PDS service DID for workload OAuth); scope is com.fedproxy.temp.oauth for workload OAuth.

roles.description: Map with exactly one key, the record key, to {role_name, definition: {iss, aud, sub, policies}}. iss is the workload's OIDC issuer, aud the audience its token must carry (<account DID>#role/<rkey> for workload OAuth), sub its subject, policies the policy names.

policies.description: Map of policy name to {meta, schemas}. schemas maps an XRPC path (or a glob with *) to a JSON Schema object with properties.capability.enum (read, create, update, delete) and optionally properties.body, a JSON Schema the request document must satisfy.
